brand.tagline: Training: from a new project to a shared schedule
brand.subtitle: Version 2.4  ·  Windows, macOS and web
outro: Questions? We are here to help

segments.speech: Welcome to the Acme Planner training. In the next few minutes you will create a project, plan its tasks, and share the schedule with your team.
The menu on the left lists everything in the order you use it. Projects, tasks, the schedule, and reports.
Choose new project, give it a name, and save. Your project opens straight away, ready for its first tasks.
Import an existing task list from a C S V file, or add tasks one by one. Drag a task to change its dates.
That is the whole workflow. The user guide explains every setting, and our support team is happy to help.
